entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Whatever. Just need to return something.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can help you with a return. Could I please get your name and order number to start?
Sarah Miller. Order number is VF88621.
Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero helmet. What specifically is the issue?
I understand. To make sure I'm noting this correctly, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is it more of a preference issue, like the fit or color?
The color is not what I expected. The box is still unopened. I never even tried it on.
Okay, thanks for clarifying. It looks like this was delivered 52 days ago. I just want to confirm there are no concerns with the safety features or anything like that, correct?
I told you, I didn't even open it. It's a helmet. It's fine. I just want my money back.

Of course. That's no problem at all, Sarah. Our standard items, like this helmet, have a 90-day return policy. You're well within that window, so I've gone ahead and approved the return for a full refund.
Oh. So you're just... doing it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out and attach it to the shipping box. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed.
Fine. I'll look for the email.
Great. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
